plugins.Author: Legends of the Game
plugins.Name: Time Memoria
plugins.Description: Quest progression and pacing — a reflective notebook for your story journey, not a scoreboard.
plugins.Punchline: Remember every step, Warriors of Light.
plugins.Changelog:
Plugin installer:
- The Settings button now opens the window you chose in Settings (Native or Classic), on its Settings tab. Before, it toggled the Classic window on whichever tab was last open.
- The Open button now opens the window you chose, and never closes it if it is already open.

Housekeeping:
- Category metadata is now part of the build itself.
- Unused notification code removed. The plugin never showed toasts or notifications, and still does not.
- README and NOTICE updated. The README now describes the one network request (the News feed). Ocean Fishing: Soon™.
